description: This file defines a PHPUnit fixture class 'I18NLangStringFixture' used for testing purposes within the OrangeHRM project. It extends an abstract fixture class and loads sample data for I18N language strings and groups from the database, returning structured arrays of entities for testing.

classes.name: OrangeHRM\Tests\Util\Fixture\I18NLangStringFixture
